title: Chapter 217 Red Flame Legion
content:
Chapter 217 Red Flame Legion

Immediately, the tiger talisman was used.

The tiger talisman is a higher-level legion order than the legion order, which can be used to form a group army.

The number of people depends on the level of the tiger talisman, and the same is true for the legion order.

Wang Shuo's tiger talisman and legion order at this time are both the lowest bronze level.

[Do you want to use the tiger talisman to establish a group army? ]

"Yes."

[Please enter the name, once confirmed, it cannot be changed. ]

"Red Flame Legion."

[Red Flame Legion was successfully created. ]

Wang Shuo incorporated all five troops except the city defense army into the Red Flame Legion, and he served as the supreme commander.

He also discussed the style of the military flag with everyone.

Then, Wang Shuo distributed the Earth Emperor Fruit to several centurions. Gong Zheng had already taken one in the underground palace, so Wang Shuo did not give it to him, because each person could only take one of this fruit.

In this way, everyone's command value reached about 20 points, and the number of soldiers they could lead increased further.

Wang Shuo took out the "circle formation" blueprint and gave it to Gong Zheng. Shield soldiers are more suitable for this formation.

The "government affairs" skill book was given to Duan Wenxi.

The "spitting blood" skill book was given to military advisor Zou Yuanjie.

The "Golden Equipment Casting Manual" was given to Matar's apprentice Wu Dong, asking him to organize the blacksmith shop to forge the weapons as soon as possible.

The battering ram blueprint and the ladder blueprint were given to the workshop manager Xu Zhongliang.

The intermediate arrow tower blueprint was given to Suo Yong.

"Duan Wenxi, who is in charge of the clinic now?" Wang Shuo took out the blood recovery pill formula and asked.

"Boss, it's a woman named Liu Feifei."

"Okay, you give this formula to her and let her study it carefully."

"You are the heroes of the territory. In the future, everyone should work together to build the territory and create a strong Wana Village. Do you have confidence!"

"Yes."

"Long live Wana Village!"

...

Everyone laughed and shouted loudly.

After Wang Shuo gave everyone a few words of advice, he asked everyone to do their job and stick to their posts!

Wang Shuo looked at the things that had not been distributed yet.

A "Craftsman's Manual", Wang Shuo planned to study it himself first, and then hand it over to the craftsman camp. After all, he was also very interested in craftsmen.

The "Dead Spirit Pearl" production drawings, this matter is of great importance, Wang Shuo also intends to master the production method in his own hands.

Walking out of the lord's mansion, Wang Shuo thought that he still had two barracks construction drawings, so he came to the city gates on the east and west sides and clicked to use them.

These two barracks drawings were seized from Fengze Village, and Wang Shuo didn't spend a penny.

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo upgraded one of them to a shield barracks and the other to a bow barracks.

The infantry barracks next to the north gate, which can train a variety of soldiers, is a panacea, far less good than a special single-attribute barracks.

Wang Shuo plans to gradually build a barracks for all arms.

After groping for a while, Wang Shuo was surprised to find

The barracks can actually be upgraded.

This made Wang Shuo overjoyed.

The newly established barracks are set as first-level barracks by default.

[Barracks upgrade conditions: To upgrade a first-level barracks to a second-level barracks, a second-level village, 50,000 energy crystals, and a junior general are required to be stationed. ]

Wana Village currently has five generals, and it is entirely possible to upgrade all four barracks to second-level barracks.

So Wang Shuo went directly to the four barracks and upgraded them to second-level.

Soldiers with ranks can improve their various attributes, combat effectiveness and defense by 10% compared to ordinary soldiers. It can be said that their strength has been greatly improved.

The advantage of a single soldier may not be obvious, but when a large-scale legion is fighting, a 10% improvement can make a fundamental difference.

Taking cavalry as an example, the cavalry of the second-level barracks can be upgraded to second-level cavalry when the level reaches 20.

The third-level barracks can be upgraded to third-level cavalry when the level reaches 30, and the various attributes, combat effectiveness and defense are increased by another 10%.

If it was the fourth or fifth level...

Wang Shuo couldn't imagine it.
